title: How to use My Tasks
summary: Your private task space — switch views, group, filter, and move work through statuses.

blocks.heading: Your private task space
paragraphs: My Tasks is visible only to you. Use it for personal work that does not belong in a shared workspace list.
Switch between List and Board, search, group, filter, sort, or use Focus today to narrow what you see.
